entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: One of the seven continents of Zendikar, in the southwestern quadrant, with a rugged mainland and three major offshore islands.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane containing the continent of Ondu.

entities.name: Agadeem
entities.description: The large southern island of Ondu, renowned for its hedron-strewn fields and crypts.

entities.name: Beyeen
entities.description: A smaller island of Ondu marked by volcanic peaks and geothermal basins.

entities.name: Jwar Isle
entities.description: A remote island of Ondu notorious for storms, onto which the Ondu Skyclave fell.

entities.name: Ondu Skyclave
entities.description: An ancient Kor skyclave that fell onto Jwar Isle in a civil war with Makindi.

entities.name: Makindi
entities.description: The capital of the ancient Kor empire, destroyed in a civil war with the Ondu Skyclave; also a region of Ondu.

entities.name: Kor empire
entities.description: An ancient empire whose heartland was Ondu.

entities.name: Eldrazi titans
entities.description: Titans whose release led to their broods teeming in Ondu's canyons and forests.

entities.name: Silundi
entities.description: A region of currents and reefs connecting Ondu's mainland with its islands.

entities.name: Turntimber
entities.description: A vast spiral forest region of Ondu with roaming baloths, giant snakes and Tajuru elf villages.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: Elves living in secluded villages in Turntimber.

events.summary: A civil war between Makindi and the Ondu Skyclave destroys Makindi and ruins the Skyclave, which falls onto Jwar Isle.
events.quote: a civil war between the city and the Ondu Skyclave caused Makindi’s destruction and the Skyclave’s ruin, which fell onto Jwar Isle

events.summary: After the release of the Eldrazi titans, their broods fill Ondu, but the land itself resists them with crystalline shards, yawning canyons and mesas that grow limbs.
events.quote: The defenders of Zendikar found an unpredictable but fierce ally in Ondu’s living terrain.

relations.quote: Ondu is one of the seven continents of Zendikar
a civil war between the city and the Ondu Skyclave
